aboutText: From our base in Ravenhall, WPG Plumbing provides expert plumbing services to homes and businesses across Melbourne's western suburbs. Our skilled team specialises in solving urgent issues like stubborn blocked drains, which can quickly become a nightmare. Whether it's a slow-draining sink, a clogged toilet, or a backed-up shower, we use the latest equipment to get your drains flowing freely again. We're committed to taking the stress out of plumbing problems with reliable, same-day service.
servicesText: We handle all residential and commercial plumbing needs, from emergency repairs to scheduled maintenance. Serving Ravenhall, Werribee, and surrounding areas with prompt, professional care.

services.title: Blocked Drain Clearing
services.desc: We use high-pressure jetters and cameras to locate and clear stubborn blockages in all pipes, restoring flow fast.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: We're available when you need us most for burst pipes, gas leaks, and other urgent plumbing crises in your home or business.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Our team accurately finds and fixes hidden water leaks to prevent damage and reduce your water bills.

services.title: Hot Water Systems
services.desc: We install, repair, and service gas and electric hot water systems to ensure you never run out of hot water.

services.title: Toilet & Tap Repairs
services.desc: From running toilets to leaky taps, we provide efficient repairs and replacements using quality parts.

services.title: General Plumbing Maintenance
services.desc: Regular maintenance helps prevent unexpected issues and keeps your property's plumbing in top condition year-round.

reviews.text: The team from WPG came out to our Ravenhall home to clear a severely blocked sewer drain. They were on time, professional, and fixed the problem quickly. Highly recommend their emergency service.
reviews.name: Mark Henderson

reviews.text: Our café in Sunshine West had a major hot water failure. WPG Plumbing arrived within the hour, diagnosed the issue, and had a new system installed the same day. Fantastic commercial service.
reviews.name: Sarah Chen

reviews.text: I manage several properties and rely on WPG for all plumbing maintenance. Their recent leak detection at a Melton rental saved the owner from serious water damage. Always reliable and fairly priced.
reviews.name: David Miller
